title.zh: Circle opens Arc mainnet as it seeks an edge for USDC utility
title.en: Circle opens Arc mainnet as it seeks an edge for USDC utility

current_state.zh: Circle launched the public mainnet of Arc, a layer-1 blockchain that lets a single USDC balance cover both payments and network fees, aiming to boost USDC utility against Tether.
current_state.en: Circle launched the public mainnet of Arc, a layer-1 blockchain that lets a single USDC balance cover both payments and network fees, aiming to boost USDC utility against Tether.
